thread:
noah: FYI rolling out 'rollforward-B' pricing experiment tomorrow 03:00 PT (5% cohort). Need final billing preflight focused on cycle alignment and pro-rata handling. @priya_fin @marcus please confirm cutover logic for monthly invoices.

priya_fin: On it. Key callouts: (1) mid-cycle subs should get pro-rated seat changes applied to old cycle and price uplift on next invoice, (2) for monthly invoices generated before the pilot cutoff we should not retroactively change historical invoices. We'll tag invoices with 'rollfwdB_trial' for 10-day review.

marcus: I'll run the preview and check invoice stitching and pro-rate math. Also verify vendor passthrough: vendor has tiered GPU pricing (0-10k min = 0.14/min, >10k = 0.11/min). Need to ensure we apply tier breakpoints on aggregated monthly usage, not per-invoice.

helen: Product wants a 10-day grandfathering window for existing subs, plus an opt-out flag for accounts on private deployments (VPC customers). Tag names: gf_10d and gf_exempt_vpc. Legal confirmed tax treatment for credits? @tara_legal

tara_legal: Credits treated as invoice adjustments; include phrase on invoice: "Temporary legacy pricing applied where eligible. See billing help." Also recommend adding a note about tax implications only if the credit exceeds invoice line-item. Good to go.

billing-bot: preview job started (id=35120) for cohort rollforward-B. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/35120

noah: Finance ask: preflight file by 12:30 PT with columns: acct_id, invoice_cycle, old_amount, new_amount, delta_usd, gf_flag, action_required. Flag deltas > $500 and any account with mixed currency invoices. Also include a small exposure summary.

marcus: Running SQL check for pro-rate edgecases: ```WITH subs AS (SELECT account_id, invoice_id, start_date, end_date, seat_count FROM billing.subscriptions) SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(seat_count * pro_rate) as prorated_seat FROM subs WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id;```

priya_fin: Vendor mapping: ratecard_id=rp_rollfwd_b_v1 mapped to vendor_sheet v5. Marcus please ensure vendor tier aggregation is by account-month, not by invoice run.

marcus: Noted. Found 2 accounts on private VPC flagged as gf_exempt_vpc; they should remain on stable rates. Adding validation to exclude accounts with tag private_deployment=true.

ops-bot: billing-preview job finished (id=35120). Uploading preflight: https://files.redwood/preflight/35120/preflight_rollfwdB.csv

marcus: Preflight summary: avg delta +0.5%, cohort net delta +$9,120, 7 accounts > $500 flagged, 3 mixed-currency invoices flagged. Vendor tier aggregation: two accounts crossed tier boundary causing larger vendor delta; flagged for manual review.

priya_fin: For the mixed-currency accounts we need FX conversion logic: billing preview used end-of-day rates but invoices settle using cached rate at invoice generation TTL=3h. Adding validation to surface any diffs > 0.5% between EOD and cached rates.

noah: CFO asked for exposure cap at $30k for this cohort. We're below but add alert if projected > $25k so execs are notified early.

helen: Product asked about quick rollback criteria: pause if cohort net delta > 12% OR >1% invoices with vendor mismatch OR more than 5 accounts with delta > $2k. Ops will implement gating.

ops-bot: gating alert rule created: post to #eng-sre and #finance if any condition met. Also auto-toggle cohort routing to rp_stable on pause. Runbook: https://playbooks/internal/rollforward-rollback

priya_fin: Special-case for legacy credits: auto-apply credits up to $400 per invoice, flag > $400 for manual credit note creation. Manual refunds > $1,000 require finance approval and ticket in #finance-ops.

marcus: Re-ran preview after small ETL patch for vendor tiers. preflight_rollfwdB_v2.csv uploaded: https://files.redwood/preflight/35121/preflight_rollfwdB_v2.csv. Summary: net delta +$8,760, 5 accounts > $500 flagged, vendor tier mismatches fixed, mixed-currency flagged but within tolerance after FX TTL fix.

noah: Great. Final checklist: pro-rate rules validated \u2705, vendor tier agg fix \u2705, gf_10d + gf_exempt_vpc tags set \u2705, preflight v2 posted \u2705, legal invoice copy approved \u2705. Launching 03:00 PT tomorrow.

tara_legal: One more note: include a link on invoice to billing-help and a short footnote for grandfathered credits. Example language provided in the doc: https://legal.redwood/billing/credit-text

helen: Remote customers on private infra: remember they require offline support for refunds. Ops will coordinate manual refund playbook for those accounts.

noah: If anything trips the gate, call the post-launch war room and we'll coordinate. Thanks all. :party_parrot:"
